descriptor: A novella to read page by page, by lamplight

voice.summary: Reads like a quiet marginal note in a well-loved book: low-voiced, a little mysterious and never in a hurry. The interface keeps out of the way so the story keeps the spotlight.
dos: Write controls as short, unshowy labels the reader barely notices
Borrow the novella's lantern and sea imagery sparingly
Confirm actions in a single calm line
donts: Loud exclamations that break the spell
Technical jargon about rendering or storage

taglines: The sea keeps a second map
Read on, the lamp is lit
One more page by lantern light
A story kept at Kestrel Point
Turn the page, mind the tide
boilerplate: The Lantern Keeper's Atlas is a novella by Isolde Marchetti, set at a lonely lighthouse, presented in a paged reader with three themes and a chapter drawer.

microcopy.success: Bookmark kept. Your place is saved
microcopy.error: This page would not turn. Try again
microcopy.empty: No bookmarks yet. Tap the corner to keep one

logo.note: An open book is the most direct picture of a reader built around a single novella.
